This is followed by a shot of soft-serve ice cream with green sauce and mint garnish. (8) The video concludes with the woman smiling and making a playful gesture toward the camera. She appears friendly and confident. The indoor environment is consistent with the opening shot, featuring the hanging plant and neutral-toned walls.
